What you leave behind

Permission

Approved by a moderator before it appears.

How this works

  • Shown: your name, path, plans, activities, memory, quote, and photo if you add one.
  • Never shown: phone number, home address, email, birthday, social handles, or student ID. We do not even ask for most of them.
  • A moderator checks that entries are from a real WHS 2027 senior and school-appropriate, then approves them.
  • Want out later? Ask for removal and it is gone.
